samples.question: The picture shows one square panel enclosed by a black frame and ruled into a grid of 7 rows and 7 columns of equal square cells. Below the panel a black-framed key strip shows three swatches: the left swatch is the colour that stands for the number 0, the middle swatch stands for 1 and the right swatch stands for 2. The panel is a smeared print of a hidden 7 by 7 pattern of inked and blank cells. Each printed cell shows, in the colour given by the key, the remainder after division by three of the number of inked cells among the hidden cell in the same place and the two hidden cells immediately to its left in the same row; cells beyond the left edge of the panel count as blank. Undo the smear row by row, working from the left edge rightwards, to recover the hidden pattern. Its inked cells form exactly one of these five symbols: bars (three separate horizontal bars stacked one above another), chevron (a wide V narrowing downwards to a single cell), plus (a full horizontal bar crossed by a vertical bar), ring (a closed ring enclosing empty cells), steps (a staircase of pairs running from the upper left down to the lower right). Which symbol do the inked cells form? Answer with one word.
